entity.summary: Digital-asset trading platform offering crypto spot and derivatives trading alongside RWA token trading. In June 2026, MSX announced the launch of its X Card payment-card product.
entity.notes: The current first-party site describes MSX as a digital-asset trading platform providing spot and derivatives trading for assets including Bitcoin and Ethereum, while also offering RWA token trading. First-party API documentation exposes spot order/account/asset interfaces and U-margined contract trading interfaces. The footer identifies Mystonks Holding LTD., but the reviewed sources do not independently establish its legal jurisdiction, so HEI uses Global and leaves launch_date null. App Store distribution corroborates an active crypto-exchange application published by Mystonks Holding LTD. The X Card item is recorded only as an issuer-announced product launch; related promotional claims are not independently adopted.

events.title: MSX announced launch of X Card payment-card product
events.description: An MSX-authored press release announced the launch of X Card as a payment-card product connected to the broader MSX platform.
events.notes: Recorded as a non-terminal product event. HEI does not independently verify the promotional operational, compliance, network or availability claims in the release.

evidence.title: MSX public trading platform
evidence.notes: Current first-party site describes crypto spot and derivatives trading plus RWA token trading. Used for active status and service-surface evidence.

evidence.title: MSX API documentation
evidence.notes: First-party REST and WebSocket documentation exposes spot trading, asset queries, market data and U-margined contract trading interfaces.

evidence.title: MSX: Buy Bitcoin & Crypto

evidence.title: MSX Launches Global Crypto Card 'X Card'
evidence.notes: Issuer-authored paid press release carried by CoinDesk. Used only to establish MSX's own X Card launch announcement.
